RWA.note: The call for proposals states nothing on rules or an authority for AI harms.

facts.fact: The Rwanda Information Society Authority with the Rwanda Public Procurement Authority invited proposals, due 15 July 2025, to develop an AI-powered commodity classification system for the UMUCYO e-procurement platform.
facts.system: AI-Powered Commodity Classification System for UMUCYO e-Procurement

RWA.note: The AI system is for public procurement, a general administration function, not a listed sector system.
The call seeks a procurement classifier, not a national AI model, dataset or AI computing facility.

facts.fact: The call for proposals describes the UMUCYO e-Procurement platform as Rwanda's existing procurement system, for which an AI classification system is sought.

RWA.note: The call invites outside startups and providers to build a system; it does not state who builds or runs government systems in general.
A public procurement for innovation call is not a startup law, labelling or fund.
The document states nothing on technology hubs or parks.
